title: fix(fields,plugin-form): the served help leg retires, and fieldHelpText moves to @object-ui/fields as the one read (objectui#12213)
body:
Fixes #12213
Clause-②: yes

## What this changes

Ruling `6134063362` (letter A): the served `help` read leg retires now. A field's help line has ONE read, `fieldHelpText`, which now lives in `@object-ui/fields`, and both readers call it.

| Reader | FROM | TO |
|---|---|---|
| Record form: `ObjectForm`'s field builder and `fromObjectSchema` | plugin-form's own `fieldHelpText`: `field.inlineHelpText \|\| field.help \|\| field.description` | `fieldHelpText` from `@object-ui/fields`: `field.inlineHelpText \|\| field.description` |
| `resolveActionParam`, for a field-backed param with no `helpText` of its own | the same order written out by hand, `help` included | `param.helpText ?? fieldHelpText(field)` |

- The two local `help` members are gone: plugin-form's `FieldHelpTextSource` goes with its copy of the function (plugin-form keeps no copy and no re-export), and `RuntimeField.help` leaves the resolver.
- The empty-string rule is unchanged: `inlineHelpText: ''` still falls back to `description` (`||`, not `??`).
- Landing point: `packages/fields` (the read, its home file `fieldHelpText.ts`, the entry's export) and `packages/plugin-form` (the two callers), as the dispatch expected. `packages/types/src/field-types.ts` changes one docblock phrase only: `fieldHelpText` now lives in `@object-ui/fields`.
- Server floor, stated in the changesets: translated field help needs an objectstack server on spec 17.7.0 or later (objectstack-ai/objectstack `bab76850c`, objectstack-ai/objectstack#21956). Against an older server, a field's help line shows its stored `description`, untranslated.

## Export closure, measured on the built declarations

A script built on the TypeScript checker lists `getExportsOfModule` of each package's `exports['.'].types` file, on a build of base `48fb558d` and on a build of this head:

| Package entry | Base | Head | Difference |
|---|---|---|---|
| `@object-ui/fields` `dist/index.d.ts` | 191 names, no `fieldHelpText` | 192 names | `fieldHelpText` only, typed `(field: Pick of BaseFieldMetadata's "inlineHelpText" and "description") => string \| undefined`, declared in `dist/fieldHelpText.d.ts`, whose one import is `BaseFieldMetadata` from `@object-ui/types` |
| `@object-ui/plugin-form` `dist/index.d.ts` | 59 names | 59 names | none: the two lists are identical |

Controls in the same runs: `resolveActionParam` PRESENT in the fields entry, `ObjectForm` PRESENT in the plugin-form entry. `FieldHelpTextSource` is not an export name at either point. Its only built home was plugin-form's `dist/sectionFields.d.ts`, a file no `exports` entry reaches, which carried it and the old function at base and carries neither now (0 hits). (Generic type arguments are spelled out in words here because GitHub strips angle-bracket spans from bodies.)

No home both readers could reach without a public export exists: `@object-ui/fields` publishes `.` and `./style.css` only, and plugin-form imports it through `.`.

## The ruling's fork clause, measured (no other producer, so no stop)

objectui `48fb558d`, outside tests and docs:
- Readers of a `.help` member: the two retired here, plus non-field shapes only (the flow inspector's config fields in `FlowNodeConfigField.tsx` and `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, `ShareDialog` options, and `BulkActionDialog`'s `BulkActionParam.help`, which `resolveBulkActions` fills from the resolver's `helpText`).
- Writers of a `help:` key: 17 files, none writing it onto a field definition (flow config fields, i18n catalogues, share options, bulk params). JSON `"help":` keys: 0 files (control `"description":` 118 files).
- The client translation transform `transformSpecTranslations` flattens a field's `label` and `options` only. The console requests `/api/v1/i18n/translations` (control hit) and never `getFieldLabels` (0 hits repo-wide).

objectstack `84643802`:
- The field translator in `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts`: `next.help =` 0 hits, control `next.description = translatedDescription` 1 hit.
- Every other `help:` hit outside tests and docs is a translation bundle entry (the translator's input), a spec alias table, the translation schema's own `help` member, a bulk-action param, or the `/i18n/labels` response (`GetFieldLabelsResponse.labels.FIELD.help`, built by `resolveObjectFieldLabels`). That last one is a separate labels document, not a field definition, and objectui never requests it, so it reaches neither reader.

## Pins, flipped from "read" to "ignored"

The repo-wide sweep of tests for a served field `help` found exactly two pins, both flipped in this round. Each now asserts the new meaning, not just the absence of the old one. (`field-metadata-inline-help-text-12213.test.ts` in types pins `help` as a refused authoring key; that stays true and is unchanged.)
- `objectFormInlineHelpText-12213.test.tsx` (plugin-form; flat, sectioned and tabbed): a field with `help` and `description` draws the `description` and not the `help` text. A new `helpOnly` field draws no help line (empty accessible description, text absent). `inlineHelpText` still wins over `help`.
- `ActionParamDialog.fieldHelpLine-12213.test.tsx` (app-shell, real resolve and real dialog): the `served` field lends its `description`. A new `helpOnly` field lends no `helpText`, and the text is not on screen.
- New: `fieldHelpText-12213.test.tsx` (fields) pins the entry export: the order, the empty-string rule, `help` ignored, and, at type level, that a typed literal carrying `help` does not compile.

## Reverse verification (from committed head `06213286`, restored and hash-checked)

Both mutations went through `ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode: anchor hit 1 to 0, blob changed, and after the run the blob equals the HEAD blob and `git diff HEAD` is empty. Vitest aliases `@object-ui/fields` to `src`, so no dist leg was needed.
- A, runtime: `fieldHelpText` reads `help` again, between `inlineHelpText` and `description`. The three pin files went from 28 passed to 7 failed and 21 passed. The 7 are the "ignored" cases: 3 form layouts, 2 dialog cases, 2 fieldHelpText cases.
- B, type level: the parameter type gains `help` again. The fields test type-check fails with `TS2578: Unused '@ts-expect-error' directive` in `fieldHelpText-12213.test.tsx`.

## Gates (all at head `06213286`)

- Builds under the shared lock: the `@object-ui/console...` closure, 35 of 35 tasks; then the `@object-ui/cli...` and `@object-ui/plugin-ai...` closures, 10 of 10.
- Type-check, each echoing its `tsc` chain, exit 0: `@object-ui/types`, `@object-ui/fields`, `@object-ui/plugin-form`, `@object-ui/plugin-grid`, `@object-ui/app-shell`.
- Tests, exit 0: `packages/fields/`, `packages/plugin-form/` and the types 12213 pin: 431 files passed, 1 skipped; 6226 tests passed, 8 skipped. The consumer set: 97 files re-derived by a grep of tests naming `resolveActionParam`, `ActionParamDialog`, `fieldHelpText` or `inlineHelpText`, plus three more from the dispatch's lead list and a wider `helpText` grep of tests (`FormPage.richTextHints-12110`, `FormPage.fieldSpec`, plugin-grid's `resolveBulkActions`): 100 files passed, 979 tests. `scripts/__tests__/`: 187 files passed, 2 skipped; 5621 tests passed.
- Exit 0: `check:readme-exports` (592 self-imports, all real, 0 unbuilt; the new README import `fieldHelpText` is judged real), `check:spec-symbols`, `check:self-import`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:designer-field-key-parity`, `check:eager-closure` (a head reading only: 3131.3 KB gzipped against a 3204.6 KB budget, headroom 73.3 KB; the base was not measured), `check:esm-specifiers`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:control-bytes`, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:dist-completeness`, `check-type-check-coverage`. The governed-surface guard on the 13 paths answers NOT GOVERNED.
- ESLint, a measured narrowing. Population: `eslint.config.js` lints `**/*.{ts,tsx}`. Run: `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the 9 touched ts/tsx files, which the JSON output counts as 9 files: 0 errors and 213 warnings. 212 of the warnings are on the base blobs of the same files. The one new warning is `react-refresh/only-export-components` on the new `fieldHelpText` re-export in `packages/fields/src/index.tsx`, the same warning the file's 53 other non-component exports carry. Invariance: no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService` (type-aware linting is off), and no rule in `eslint-rules/` reads another file, so this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file.

## Changesets

- `.changeset/12213-fields-field-help-text-export.md` (new, `@object-ui/fields` minor): the new export, with the `Clause-②` line.
- `.changeset/12213-plugin-form-inline-help-text.md` and `.changeset/12213-fields-action-param-help.md` are EDITED, patch to minor. Both are unreleased: the three CHANGELOGs carry 0 mentions of 12213. Each said the `help` leg is still read, which this change makes false within the same release. Each now states the change from the last release (FROM `help` first, TO `inlineHelpText || description`) and carries the BREAKING section with the server floor. `check-changeset-overwrite` (report-only) lists both as modified, its case 2: a deliberate correction.
- `@object-ui/types` gets no new changeset: one docblock phrase in its shipped `.d.ts`, with no change to behaviour or surface. Its pending `12213-types-inline-help-text.md` stays true. `@object-ui/app-shell` changes a test only.

## Acceptance notes

- Two notes from the first round (PR objectui#12236) stand as they were, not touched here, with no carrier: Studio's `ObjectFormCanvas` draws `description` only, and a `plugin-detail` comment lists `help` among the keys the spec's `translateObject` reads.
- Inside the claimed files, two neighbour docblocks moved with the edit: `RuntimeField.inlineHelpText`'s doc names `fieldHelpText`, and `RuntimeField.description` gained a one-line doc.
